name: Take Two With Water
summary: Loremaster Dibbs asks you to gather legends from the Drowned City, where he believes the lost troll city of I’lalai has risen. He calls it possibly the archaeological discovery of the century.

sections.title: Dibbs’s Discovery
sections.body: Loremaster Dibbs has read a scouting report and troll legends that suggest I’lalai, a lost troll city, has risen off Stranglethorn’s coast. He asks you to bring back legends from the Drowned City. The discovery could change what is known of the ancient ruins.

sections.title: The Tablets
sections.body: Dibbs welcomes you back from the troll ruins and is eager to hear what you found. Four tablets offer new legends, though his ancient Zandali is rusty. He thinks their words may name an unfamiliar loa associated with the tides.

faq.q: Who is asking for these legends?
faq.answer: Loremaster Dibbs asks you to collect legends from the Drowned City.
Dibbs believes it may be the lost troll city of I’lalai, risen off Stranglethorn’s coast.

faq.q: What does Dibbs want me to bring back?
faq.answer: He asks you to make charcoal rubbings of tablets found in the Drowned City and bring back the legends.

faq.q: Why does Dibbs want the legends?
faq.answer: He believes the scouting report and troll legends may point to the lost city of I’lalai.
Dibbs believes I’lalai has risen just off the coast of Stranglethorn.
